values.note: Two sections under ponderosa pine; maximum spur 35 ft, but not all sites fit that length. Several sites park side by side with little privacy.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/upper-beaver-creek-campground ('The campground has 14 sites in two sections laid out under ponderosa pines. Parking on several sites is side-by-side'; 'Maximum spur length is 35 feet. Not all sites will fit vehicles of this length.'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Water and concessionaire trash service only in the summer season (Memorial Day weekend - Labor Day weekend); off-season, no water and pack out trash.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/upper-beaver-creek-campground ('Vault toilet(s)'; 'Water is available in the campground during the summer season, typically Memorial Day Weekend to Labor Day Weekend. Outside of the summer season, potable water is NOT available'; 'Trash service is provided by the concessionaire from Memorial Day to Labor Day.'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: $27 a single site, $54 a double, during concessionaire operations (Memorial Day - Labor Day); $10 a night in the shoulder season before and after. Day use $12. Cash or check; fee envelopes at the entrance.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/upper-beaver-creek-campground ('Single Site: $27 per night'; 'Double Site: $54 per night'; 'Shoulder Season (before and after Concessionaire operations): $10.00/night'; 'Concessionaire operations for the 2026 season will begin May 22nd ... Off-season fees of $10.00/night apply.'), read 2026-10-28

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/upper-beaver-creek-campground ('All sites are first come, first served and cannot be reserved.'; '14-day camping limit.'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: The full campground is open Memorial Day weekend to Labor Day weekend; 4 sites stay open year-round at the off-season fee, but may be inaccessible due to snow or spring road closures.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/upper-beaver-creek-campground ('The full campground is open from Memorial Day weekend to Labor Day weekend. 4 of the campsites remain open year-round, but may be inaccessible due to snow levels or spring road closures.'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Senior/Access passes: 50% off single sites only.

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/upper-beaver-creek-campground ('Interagency Senior/Access Recreation Passes provide a 50% discount to single campsites ONLY.'), read 2026-10-28

note: Rio Grande NF, on Beaver Creek Rd (FR 360, gravel) ~3.75 mi from US-160 W of South Fork, ~8,500 ft, under ponderosa pine near Beaver Creek. Beaver Creek Reservoir (no-wake boating, concrete ramp, trout and kokanee fishing) is just up the road. --Claude
summary: FS page (Oct 2026): confirmed 14 sites in two sections, max spur 35 (not all fit), FCFS only, vault toilets, summer water, $27 ($54 double) / $10 shoulder; added 14-day limit, season (4 sites year-round, full campground Memorial Day-Labor Day), 50% pass discount, fees checked 2026. Hookups untouched (page silent). Note cleaned of field facts.
flags: Phone: none stored. Divide Ranger District, 13308 West US Hwy 160, Del Norte, (719) 657-3321 (FS page contact). Suggest it.

Road: Beaver Creek Rd is FR 360 (not FR 20): FS road atlas, maintenance level 3 'suitable for passenger cars', crushed aggregate/gravel; campground spur FR 360.4A, same. The Rio Grande NF conditions page (updated Oct 28 2026) lists Divide RD flood-damaged roads FSR 410, 380, 390, 430 and 438; FR 360 is not among them and the FS campground page carries no closure. FS directions: 'go 3 miles to Lower Beaver campground sign. Keep going another .75 miles' (the old note's '~4.75 mi from US-160' counted the 1.4 mi on US-160; corrected to 3.75 mi on Beaver Creek Rd).
Rig length: 'Maximum spur length is 35 feet. Not all sites will fit vehicles of this length.' Over 23 ft; no criteria problem.
Status: in the off season now (no water, trash or host; $10/night; all FCFS). Ordinary seasonal, not a closure.

Waterfront 'not waterfront' kept: on NAIP Beaver Creek (~4-6 m wide, creek-sized) runs SW of the campground under continuous conifer canopy, ~40-60 m from the loop/sites with no open apron visible. The reservoir is farther up FR 360, out of the frame. Not earned.
